# InTheFinals

> InTheFinals is a live interview assistant that listens to your shared Chrome or Edge call tab, transcribes the interviewer, and generates concise answers grounded in your resume and job description.

InTheFinals helps candidates during live interviews on shared browser call tabs (Zoom, Meet, Teams in Chrome/Edge). It continuously transcribes interviewer speech and suggests speakable answers tied to the candidate’s own resume and job context—not generic chatbot scripts.

## Product

- Name: InTheFinals
- Category: Live interview assistant / AI interview copilot
- Marketing site: https://inthefinals.ai
- Web app: https://app.inthefinals.ai
- Support: info@inthefinals.ai
- Company: ASH IT Consulting Inc., 42 Industrial Street, Toronto, Ontario, Canada

## How it works

1. Set up resume and job description context in the app.
2. Share the Chrome or Edge interview call tab and start listening.
3. Use transcript-backed, resume-grounded answer suggestions during the interview.

## Who it suits

Power BI, SQL, Azure, Microsoft Fabric, data engineering, business analysis, and IT consulting professionals who need clear answers under live interview pressure.

## Pricing (as published on site)

Two free live sessions, then CA$14.99 per month for 7 sessions. Cancel anytime. Create a free account at https://app.inthefinals.ai/signup
